content: Go libp2p gossipsub (master, verified from raw source): per-peer outbound queue default 32 RPCs (peerOutboundQueueSize=32, option WithPeerOutboundQueueSize, must be positive). Queue is a two-lane priority queue (rpcQueue): UrgentPush for control RPCs, Push normal. On full: non-blocking push returns ErrQueueFull and gossipsub router drops the RPC for that peer via doDropRPC(rpc,p,'queue full') with tracer.DropRPC visibility - NO disconnect. Subscribe announce messages get a scheduled retry (announceRetry) on queue-full. Dead peers respawn writer with backoff (deadPeerBackoff).
